title: ActivityEvent
description: A single observed user-activity event captured by the desktop agent (and, for browser apps, the DOM extension). This is the raw, evidence-level signal that the Keboola AI pipeline segments into steps and processes. One row in in.c-jazz.activity_events maps to one ActivityEvent. Secrets and credentials (passwords, tokens, keys) and label-gated-off content are always masked before persistence; the high-fidelity data-capture mode (ADR 0003 contract 5) deliberately RETAINS business values (e.g. ARR, customer names, record-ids) under explicit opt-in consent — those are the recording's deliverable, not a leak, and are governed by a retention policy rather than by masking.

sessionId.description: Capture-session identifier. Used as the case/trace correlation key (maps to OTLP trace_id when streaming).

eventId.description: Monotonic, session-unique event id. Referenced from L4 evidence[] arrays.

sequence.description: Monotonic ordinal within the session; resilient to clock skew.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the event.

url.description: Legacy context carrier. Native clients use app://<bundle-id>; browser producers may retain their legacy page URL. Consumers use application and documentURL when present.

application.description: Observed OS/browser application identity, distinct from document URL and any derived business system.

documentURL.description: Sanitized observed document/page context. Native HTTP(S) values omit userinfo, query, and fragment; local file context retains only a basename. Never a stable business-object identity.

system.description: Legacy display hint for the observed app/system. It is not authoritative application or business-system identity; use application for the former and connector-verified derived assertions for the latter.

target.description: Semantic description of the interaction target (for click/input/change/submit).

accessibleName.description: Computed accessible name (dom-accessibility-api). Approximation of the real AX tree.

text.description: Visible text label, masked if flagged sensitive.

selectorCandidates.description: Ordered, most-stable-first locator candidates for replay/identification.

attributes.description: Allowlisted, non-sensitive element attributes (e.g. type, name, placeholder). Sensitive values are omitted or masked.

boundingBox.description: Element rect in viewport coordinates (for screenshot annotation).

value.description: Input/change value AFTER masking. Never contains raw secrets or unmasked PII.

selectedText.description: Text the user had selected on/at the interaction (AX kAXSelectedText), e.g. a word selected by double-click or a range selected by drag. Captures the SELECTION (what is highlighted), distinct from target.text (the element's full value). Masked when the field is sensitive; governed by the same retention policy as other business values.

clipboardText.description: Bounded clipboard payload observed for a paste event. Copy/cut rely on selectedText because the pasteboard may still be stale at key-down. This is transfer evidence, not proof of success or source identity; sensitive destinations omit it.

clickCount.description: OS click state for one completed click/contextmenu/drag observation: 1 = single, 2 = double-click, 3 = triple. Left gestures are published on mouse-up, once, as either click or drag.

dragEnd.description: For a 'drag' event: the point (screen/viewport coordinates) where the mouse button was released. The drag START is the event's target/location; selectedText carries any resulting text selection.

gestureId.description: Globally unique local correlation id for one physical pointer gesture. A completed drag is emitted once rather than as an initial click plus drag.

inputMasked.description: True only if sensitive content in the value field was actually replaced at capture time. Ordinary unmodified keyboard input omits this property.

isSensitive.description: True if the target/field was classified sensitive (password, detected PII, allowlist policy).

screenshotId.description: Reference to a screenshot blob stored in Keboola Files (tagged session:<id>). Empty if no frame captured for this event. Binary never travels inside the event row.

audioFileId.description: Reference to a narration audio blob in Keboola Files (tagged session:<id>), set on a 'narration' event. The audio — and its later Whisper transcript — is time-aligned to events by (event.timestamp - session start) within the same trace. Binary never travels inside the event row.

rrwebChunkId.description: Optional reference to the rrweb DOM-recording chunk covering this event, for high-fidelity replay.

labelId.description: Stable id of the active label (bracketed segment), minted at label start. Stamped onto every event captured while a label is open ('' / absent when no label is active). Set on 'label_start'/'label_end' events, which are themselves the segment boundaries. Downstream treats a label as an authoritative activity boundary.

label.description: Human-readable name of the active label (e.g. 'sales commissions'), as declared by the user at label start. Stamped onto every event captured while the label is open; absent when no label is active.

processId.description: Stable id of the Process (from the Area's process inventory) this bracketed segment demonstrates; stamped per label like labelId. Segment-scoped. Absent/'' when the segment isn't anchored to a process. The session's Area is carried as the 'area.id' OTLP attribute (session-scoped, like session.kind), not an event field. See docs/adr/0002-scope-hierarchy.md.

process.description: Human-readable name of the Process this segment demonstrates (e.g. 'Invoicing'); absent when the segment isn't process-anchored.
